name: plex-dbrepair
description: You must mount your Plex container's appdata folder into this container. Example: /mnt/user/appdata/plex Inside this folder you should see the directory structure: Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server Do NOT mount the Library folder itself. Mount the parent Plex appdata directory. The script runs once automatically and repairs the Plex database, then the container exits. No Plex container or Plex process should be running during repair. Check container logs to monitor progress. You may also open the console and run "top" to verify activity.

paths.name: Plex Appdata Folder
paths.description: THE OTHER CONTAINERS APPDATA FOLDER!!! The Path to your Plex container appdata folder (the folder that CONTAINS the 'Other Plex Containers Library' directory). Example: /mnt/user/appdata/plex. Inside this folder, you should see 'Library'. Do NOT mount the Library folder itself!

paths.name: Docker Run Socket
paths.description: Required to manage Plex containers from Unraid.

variables.name: DBREPAIR_MODE
variables.description: automatic (check, vacuum, reindex) · check (integrity check only) · vacuum (optimize database) · repair (alias for vacuum) · reindex (rebuild indexes) · deflate (VACUUM INTO rewrite) · prune (clear PhotoTranscoder cache)

variables.name: ALLOW_PLEX_KILL
variables.description: T/F If enabled, the container will stop running Plex containers before database operations begin. Requires /var/run/docker.sock.

variables.name: PLEX_CONTAINER_MATCH
variables.description: Pattern used to identify Plex containers to stop by name or image.

variables.name: RESTART_PLEX
variables.description: T/F Restart Plex containers after repairs complete.

variables.name: PRUNE_DAYS
variables.description: Files older than this number of days will be removed from the PhotoTranscoder cache when using DBREPAIR_MODE=prune.

variables.name: ENABLE_BACKUPS
variables.description: T/F Create timestamped database backups before any changes.

variables.name: RESTORE_LAST_BACKUP
variables.description: T/F Restore most recent backup and exit.

variables.name: EXCLUDE_CONTAINER_NAMES
variables.description: CSV list of containers that should never be stopped.

variables.name: EXCLUDE_IMAGE_REGEX
variables.description: Image regex used to avoid stopping the dbrepair container itself.
